comment: THE SEVEN REQUIRED CHECKS, one list with two readers (R-2026-09-29-171, EU-3 b). tests/compliance/ci_required_checks_not_paths_filtered.test.ts holds ci.yml's job set equal to this list, so it decays LOUDLY: adding or renaming a job reds that test, and adding a job to CI should require someone to decide whether it gates merges. scripts/pr_evidence.mjs reads it from its own checkout and requires each of these jobs, from the named attempt, in the evidence block. Neither reader restates the list.
